description: Server-side data provider for dropdown components (TmFilterableDropdown, TmMultiSelect). Implement this interface to provide paginated, searchable items from any data source (API, database, etc.).

typeParameters.name: TItem
typeParameters.description: The item type returned by the provider.

methods.name: GetItemsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves items matching the search criteria.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Search parameters including text, pagination, and excluded IDs.

examples.title: Basic implementation
Usage in component
examples.code:
<TmMultiSelect TItem="UserDto" TValue="int"
               DataProvider="@_userProvider"
               DisplayField="@(u => u.Name)"
               ValueField="@(u => u.Id)"
               @bind-Values="_selectedUserIds" />

@code {
    private UsersDropdownProvider _userProvider = new();
    private List<int> _selectedUserIds = new();
}
